key_catalyst: Alphabet Q2 beat overshadowed by capex guidance raise to $195–205B, alongside Brent crude topping $95 as Iran rejects peace talks.
reasoning: Alphabet's after-hours selloff on raised capex guidance directly challenges AI-ROI assumptions, while oil surges above $95 and Treasury yields at multi-year highs create a macro storm not seen in prior sessions. The market's prior resilience (flat on 7/20, +1.85% on 7/21) buckled on 7/22 (-0.51%) and today's -1.58% pre-market drop signals a delayed but now intensified repricing of these compounding risks.
